title: Known senders table should only be inserted to when the task is coming from an email
summary: The Known Senders table now only gets populated when tasks arrive from email, preventing unwanted entries when tasks are created by manually uploading PDFs.
key_points: Restricts population of the PA Known Sender table to email-sourced tasks only
Prevents table entries when tasks are created through manual PDF uploads
Uses the same source-distinguishing approach as GetAgentTaskMessagePageId
Fixes issue where table was incorrectly populated for non-email task creation
quote: The table was getting populated when creating tasks by manually uploading a PDF. This functionality is scoped to tasks received by email.
